top_signals.title: Carlyle Says Deal to Buy Lukoil International Assets Expired
top_signals.summary: US private equity giant Carlyle Group said its agreement to buy most of Lukoil PJSC foreign assets has terminated.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Why China Generates Too Much Power
top_signals.summary: China is racing to power a future of artificial intelligence and robots with renewables. But as it builds more electricity capacity than ever before, it faces a new challenge: whether the grid can keep up. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft banned from sponsoring foreign workers for US residency
top_signals.summary: Announcement impacting several tech groups marks White House’s latest attempt to limit immigration

top_signals.title: The EU budget continues delivering for Europe in 2025
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 08 Oct 2026 Today, the Court of Auditors (ECA) published its Annual Report, giving the EU's annual accounts a clean bill of health for the 19th consecutive year. The ECA confirmed that the collection of EU revenues was free from material error.
